title: Services slice: HTTP API, SNMP, and TFTP Server
acceptance_criteria: Backend service wrappers exist for https, snmp, and tftp-server with capabilities/config/batch endpoints.
System Services has form-driven tabs for HTTP API, SNMP, and TFTP Server without free-form CLI input.
Services sidebar includes HTTP API, SNMP, and TFTP Server links in A-Z order.
Runtime/browser smoke includes new service tabs and passes.
Coverage artifacts regenerate and show services backlog improvement.
assumptions: SNMPv3 advanced options are a follow-up slice.
Current wrappers continue to use command-string batch payloads under strict service subtree validation.
Unrelated dirty worktree files remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Added wrappers and tests for three new service domains.
Implemented form-driven service tabs and wired navigation.
Expanded smoke routes to include new service pages and validated runtime/browser smoke.
Updated crawler service-wrapper detection and regenerated parity artifacts.
Manual reviewer pass complete; no API contract breakages introduced.
